s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with seizures, hemiparesis, and developmental delays
salient_findings: Upper motor neuron pattern of weakness
Focal abnormal brain activity on EEG
key_facts: Age of seizure onset: 3 months
Seizures have increased in frequency despite antiepileptic therapy
Delayed motor and cognitive milestones
Behavioral changes, including disturbed sleep and irritability
No family history of neurological disorders
No perinatal complications or trauma
Normal routine laboratory studies, including metabolic and infectious panels
EEG shows focal abnormal brain activity
MRI shows cerebral hemisphere atrophy and ex vacuo dilatation of the lateral ventricle
Ipsilateral calvarial thickening and compensatory hyperpneumatization of the sphenoid bone and bilateral mastoid air cells
Cystic encephalomalacia and gliosis in the right fronto-parieto-temporal region
